summary: A dense Terra Mystica successor where you terraform hexes into your faction's home terrain, build up an interlocking network of structures, and race up tech tracks for bonuses and abilities. Every action is an efficiency puzzle with almost no randomness, and the tension comes from tight resource conversion and racing opponents for key upgrades and adjacency spots.
praised: Extremely deep, tight economic engine with satisfying resource conversion puzzles
Cleaner, more flexible structure than Terra Mystica (tech tree instead of fixed favor tiles, more varied scoring)
Rewards long-term planning and efficient turn optimization
criticised: Very high rules and strategic complexity, steep learning curve
Long playtime, especially with more players or new players
Analysis paralysis prone due to the depth of optimization
Low direct interaction can make it feel solitaire-ish despite spatial competition
Overwhelming for casual or first-time players

interaction.kind: blocking and area denial via terrain/adjacency competition

scoring.why: Points accumulate from terraforming, building, cult/tech track advancement, faction abilities, and end-game bonuses, so the winner is whoever optimizes the most scoring channels simultaneously
